authorizations.rationale: Authorize #595's exact frozen Spotlight convergence fix: Capability Admission hydrates the unique discovered PR before trusting full-PR metadata, and Spotlight verifies the complete multiline approval comment by exact JSON equality. Required checks, candidate-data trust boundaries, ruleset enforcement, and exact-head merge remain fail-closed; no bypass is added.

No new endpoint, mutation class, permission, bypass, direct-main authority, or candidate execution is added.
